text: Milovan Đilas was tried again over The New Class, first published in 1957. He was charged with being "hostile to the people and the state of Yugoslavia" and received a seven-year sentence.
meta_description: Milovan Đilas's The New Class led to a trial and a seven-year sentence in Yugoslavia for being hostile to the people and the state.
changes: Added publication year and 'another trial' from the sources; kept charge and sentence verbatim.
